newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong ceramic makers to get GITIC-backed loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong ceramic makers to get GITIC-backed loan.

text.p: BZW Asia is arranging a US$40 million project financing to help fund ceramic manufacturing in China's Guandong province, bankers said.

The borrowers are related companies Guangdong New Century Building Material Industrial Co Ltd, which will borrow US$30 million, and Maoming Times Building Material Industrial Co Ltd, which will borrow US$10 million.
The deal is guaranteed by Guangdong International Trust and Investment Corp, bankers said.
The amortising loan has a final maturity of four years with an average life of 2.5 years. It pays an interest margin of 127.5 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for underwriters is 145 basis points.
Proceeds will be used to refinance previous debt of the borrowers and for expansion of production capacity for manufacturing ceramic.
An underwriting group is being formed.
